_about: Batch B7b (Serving features): concepts/speculative-decoding, concepts/sampling-and-logits-processors, concepts/lora-serving, concepts/multimodal-serving, concepts/pooling-and-embeddings. Owner: the B7b writer.

speculative-config.short: The config of speculative decoding. --speculative-config takes it as a JSON object: method, model, num_speculative_tokens and more.
speculative-config.long: Class at {{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:387}}; the CLI keeps the JSON as a dict until the engine config is built ({{cite vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:1851-1857}}).

draft-model.short: A small separate language model that proposes tokens for a larger target model. In vLLM it is the method draft_model.
draft-model.long: It is also the method vLLM picks when the model name gives no other hint ({{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:1186-1195}}).

eagle.short: A speculative method with a small draft head that reads the target model's hidden states. vLLM has eagle and eagle3.
eagle.long: use_eagle() is true for eagle, eagle3, mtp, dflash and dspark ({{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:2013-2017}}).

mtp.short: Multi-token prediction: extra layers in the checkpoint that predict the next tokens. vLLM uses them as a drafter with the method mtp.
mtp.long: Model-specific names such as deepseek_mtp are deprecated and become mtp ({{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:1197-1201}}).

rejection-sampler.short: The sampler that checks draft tokens against the target model's distribution, keeps the accepted prefix and adds one recovered or bonus token.
rejection-sampler.long: Model Runner V2 class at {{cite vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/rejection_sampler.py:147}}; variants standard, synthetic, block, fly ({{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:83}}).

acceptance-rate.short: Accepted draft tokens divided by proposed draft tokens. The mean acceptance length is 1 + accepted tokens per verification round.
acceptance-rate.long: PromQL in the docstring of SpecDecodingProm ({{cite vllm/v1/spec_decode/metrics.py:177-196}}).

num-speculative-tokens.short: k, the number of draft tokens per request per step. A decode then has 1 + k query tokens.
num-speculative-tokens.long: No default; it comes from n_predict of the draft config when present ({{cite vllm/config/speculative.py:393-395}}).

sampling-params.short: The per-request sampling settings: temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, penalties, seed, stop rules, logprobs and more.
sampling-params.long: Class at {{cite vllm/sampling_params.py:271}}. The OpenAI server builds it from the request and the server defaults.

logprobs.short: Log probabilities of the sampled token and the top alternatives, returned per output token (logprobs) or per prompt token (prompt_logprobs).
logprobs.long: Capped by --max-logprobs, default 20 ({{cite vllm/config/model.py:286}}); raw or processed values by --logprobs-mode ({{cite vllm/config/model.py:291-299}}).

logits-processor.short: Code that changes the logits of the batch before sampling. Model Runner V2 runs built-in ones (bias, penalties, bad words) and custom ones.
logits-processor.long: V2 interface: add_request(slot), apply_staged_writes(), apply(logits, ctx) ({{cite vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/logits_processor/interface.py:92-158}}).

lora-request.short: The small object that names one LoRA adapter for a request: lora_name, lora_int_id and lora_path.
lora-request.long: A msgspec struct ({{cite vllm/lora/request.py:8-29}}); equality and hash use only the name.

punica.short: The object that runs the batched LoRA kernels (shrink and expand) for a batch in which each token can use a different adapter.
punica.long: The platform names the class; CUDA uses PunicaWrapperGPU ({{cite vllm/platforms/cuda.py:577-578}}).

lora-slot.short: One of max_loras GPU positions in the stacked LoRA buffers. An active adapter is copied into a free slot.
lora-slot.long: Slots are filled in activate_adapter ({{cite vllm/lora/model_manager.py:355-412}}); the LRU manager frees the oldest when all are used.

mm-processor.short: The per-model class that turns the HF processor output into tensors and placeholder tokens in the prompt (BaseMultiModalProcessor).
mm-processor.long: Abstract base at {{cite vllm/multimodal/processing/processor.py:1032}}; registered on the model class with MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_processor.

placeholder-token.short: A prompt token that stands for one embedding of an image, audio or video item. The model replaces it with encoder output.
placeholder-token.long: The processor inserts as many placeholders as the encoder gives embeddings ({{cite vllm/multimodal/processing/processor.py:1816-1826}}).

encoder-cache.short: Storage for multimodal encoder outputs, keyed by the item hash. The scheduler budgets it in embeddings; the worker keeps the tensors.
encoder-cache.long: Scheduler side EncoderCacheManager ({{cite vllm/v1/core/encoder_cache_manager.py:19}}); worker side EncoderCache in Model Runner V2 ({{cite vllm/v1/worker/gpu/mm/encoder_cache.py:8-13}}).

pooling-model.short: A model that returns vectors or scores (embeddings, classes, rewards) instead of generated text. vLLM runs it with --runner pooling.
pooling-model.long: Runner types generate, pooling and draft ({{cite vllm/config/scheduler.py:20}}); --convert embed or classify adapts a generative architecture ({{cite vllm/config/model.py:124-128}}).

pooler.short: The model's last module for pooling tasks: it reduces hidden states to one vector per request (LAST, MEAN, CLS) or keeps one per token (ALL, STEP).
pooler.long: Interface at {{cite vllm/model_executor/layers/pooler/abstract.py:16-34}}; settings in PoolerConfig ({{cite vllm/config/pooler.py:30}}).

embedding-endpoint.short: POST /v1/embeddings of the OpenAI-compatible server. It exists only when the model supports the embed task, or when its selected task is token_embed.
